analyst.summary: Navin Fluorine makes specialty fluorochemicals used in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, aluminium smelting and refrigeration, and just posted an exceptional year -- revenue up 41% and profit up 130% -- likely helped by global refrigerant-gas transition dynamics and new contract-manufacturing capacity coming online. But this pace is well above the company's own multi-year growth trend, and the expansion has been funded with rising debt and higher interest costs. The stock has re-rated sharply and now trades at a very rich valuation that assumes this exceptional growth continues. We rate it a Hold, but are flagging the gap between this year's growth spike and the company's longer-term trend for portfolio-manager attention.
